data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to set numeric badges on app icons for iOS, Android, and macOS
data.what_it_does: Provides an API to update or remove badge counts on the app icon. It handles platform-specific permissions and launcher support checks.
use_when: You need to display a numeric badge on the app icon
You want a single API for iOS, Android, and macOS
avoid_when: You only need in-app badge widgets
You need advanced badge styling beyond a number
strengths: Active maintenance with recent Flutter SDK compatibility
weaknesses: Requires manual permission handling on Android/iOS
No support for custom badge widgets inside the app
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, add required Android permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, request notification permission on Android/iOS if needed
